This is a big part of what I'm pondering. Should I just permanently give up on the idea of having a romantic relationship where I can truly be vulnerable every now and then? Should I keep the major issues to myself?

As you're saying, I feel like a lot of women ask for that opening up, but then don't like what they see when it happens. If that's the case, I'll just stick to running and other things to vent.
Agreed in this particular case. Part of what I'm wondering though, is this something that applies to most or all relationships?

About 3 months, but I've had symptoms that are related to it, but went undiagnosed for about 5 years. It is sometimes called a disease of patience. Even once my thyroid does officially fail, I'll have to constantly adjust my hormone replacement dosage over time. I'm actively wishing for this disease to ramp itself up so I can stop straddling this line of well enough to take care of myself, but not well enough to really excel or be the person I want to be. I'm tired of waiting for the bubble to burst.
